summary: Full Python agent fleet shipped. 14 specialists + Commander + base + services. Hungarian allocator, ensemble classifier, Monte Carlo forecaster, contradiction-aware verifier, recovery loop with audit log. 10/10 tests green; end-to-end CLI run produces 2 incidents/10 dispatches/12 messages for scenario A.
lessons: Mocking the LLM by default (with real Gemini behind GEMINI_API_KEY) lets every test run offline and is faster than hitting the API.
Expert correction needs to BOTH boost target hypothesis AND dampen competitors — additive-only wasn't enough to overcome accumulated flood evidence.
Pure-Python ray-casting PIP avoided a shapely install and keeps the dep surface lean.
